data.name: Attractor K7
data.detailed_description:
Inspired by "Samosbor" and "SCP"

ATTRACTOR K7 was born from the fusion of these two universes. A world where labyrinths of abandoned apartments morph right in the middle of your run.

Will you escape to the safe zone, or meet your end during the Refracture? It all comes down to your own greed.


Add Attractor K7 to wishlist


About the Game

An uncompromising PvE extration shooter with horror elements, set inside an endless, enclosed Megastructure.

Within the walls of the Megastructure, a reality-warping anomaly was born: the Refracture. This is a catastrophic geometric shift that instantly reshapes the labyrinth of abandoned apartments. Corridors collapse, walls physically shift, and familiar paths turn into dead ends right before your eyes.

You are just an ordinary liquidator. A disposable resource in the hands of a totalitarian machine. Your task is simple: descend via the elevator deep into the abandoned industrial zones and residential blocks, gather valuable loot, execute the Commissar’s orders, and make it back to the blast doors in time. The survivor takes everything—but the dead lose their entire inventory.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains no scenes of a sexual nature, nor does it include any dialogue or references to sexual themes. Attractor K7 is a grim, post-apocalyptic experience where players fight against unique monsters born of this world. Any resemblance to existing creatures is purely coincidental. The game features intense atmosphere, depictions of violence, and disturbing imagery consistent with a horror-survival setting.
